_note: The shared study library: free, public study links for each subject, shown beside a student's own classes at /pathway/[personId]/study. Started from Study Commons, a Pacifica student's project (github.com/TheEnigmaticPhilosopher/study-commons); links only, nothing is mirrored or stored. Faculty can edit this file. A class gets the FIRST subject whose `match` phrase appears in its title (lowercase, order matters: put the more specific subject first). A resource with `courses` shows only for classes whose title contains one of those phrases. `kind` is one of: Past exam, Practice, Open reading, Reference. URLs must start with https://. Nothing about any student belongs here.
